hypothesis_verdicts.B_sequential_pair_double_dip_after_sl: POLICY CAPABILITY CONFIRMED, SECOND LOSS DISPROVED: occupancy lock releases after closure; BTC sibling attempted10:26 afterETH09:29 stops, but all three final peer guards refused. No compounded second filled loss.
hypothesis_verdicts.C_pr219_carried_arm_peer_defect: NOT SUPPORTED by filled trades: all three ETH arms originated09:08 in same08:00 session; no carried arm; peer BTC origin08:00 and fresh final signed move44.14–47.74bp. This cohort does not independently test future carried-arm rollover.
hypothesis_verdicts.D_sizing_or_slippage_breach: Initial price-risk sizing passed0.6% in all three; actual losses exceed1R by3.2–5.8% due adverse stop fills0.35–0.63USD/ETH beyond initial stops. A risk budget is not a guaranteed broker stop fill.
hypothesis_verdicts.E_market_reversal_regime: SUPPORTED: valid short confirmation followed a brief downward impulse; ETH reversed upward and hit original stops about15min later. Recorded executable MFE only0.069–0.083R; no retained+0.70R observation. This is one economic signal replicated across three demos.
